name: What hidden issues are most common during custom kitchen remodels in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: What hidden issues are most common during custom kitchen remodels in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What hidden issues are most common during custom kitchen remodels in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hidden issues are one of the biggest reasons custom kitchen remodels in Los Angeles become more expensive or take longer than planned. Older homes often reveal outdated plumbing, insufficient electrical capacity, damaged framing, subfloor problems, termite or moisture damage, and earlier remodels that were not built well. Once demolition starts, these issues can’t be ignored because the new kitchen depends on a sound structure and safe utilities. That is why a contingency reserve and a flexible schedule are so important. The best prevention is thorough preconstruction inspection and clear communication about what might be uncovered. A contractor should explain which items are visible now, which risks are likely, and how unexpected conditions will be approved before extra work begins. When hidden issues are handled early and transparently, the project is much less likely to derail.
acceptedAnswer.description: The most common hidden issues are outdated plumbing, old electrical wiring, uneven floors, damaged framing, and previous unpermitted work. These problems often appear after demolition and can change the budget and timeline.
